import { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';

// Sample: sprite-mode node whose primary content is MSDF text (kinetic-text).
// renderMode='sprite'. Demonstrates the text + primitive iteration pattern
// without an imageUrl backing texture (image is the typography).

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const group = new Group();
  group.name = 'node:' + config.nodeId;
  group.userData.handlers = {};

  const geo = new PlaneGeometry(1, 1);
  const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    mat.map = ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl);
  }
  const mesh = new Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.userData.billboard = true;
  group.add(mesh);

  for (const primitive of config.cinematicPrimitives ?? []) {
    ctx.primitives[primitive.name](group, primitive.params);
  }

  for (const text of config.textContent ?? []) {
    if (!text || !text.text) continue;
    const t = ctx.fontAtlas.createText({
      text: text.text,
      size: text.typography?.fontSize ?? 64,
      weight: text.typography?.fontWeight ?? 700,
    });
    group.add(t);
  }

  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    geo.dispose();
    mat.dispose();
    if (mat.map && mat.map.dispose) mat.map.dispose();
  };

  return group;
}
